description: This Java source file defines the class SshFtpClient, which implements methods for connecting to, transferring files to, listing, and closing an SFTP connection over SSH. It leverages Apache SSHD and commons-io libraries for SSH communication and IO utilities.

classes.name: SshFtpClient
classes.description: A Java class providing SSH-based SFTP file transfer functionalities including connect, copy, list, and close operations.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an SSH session and initiates an SFTP connection using provided hostname, username, password, port, and timeout.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from an InputStream to a specified remote file path on the SFTP server.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists filenames in the specified directory on the SFTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting binary transfer mode; currently does nothing.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting passive mode; currently does nothing.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the SFTP and SSH session connections.
